# KLIPY

> KLIPY is an AI-native expression and interactive media platform for GIFs, stickers, memes, short video clips, AI-powered creation, and mini-games. KLIPY provides media discovery APIs for messaging apps, social networks, keyboards, and other digital products, alongside a consumer platform for finding, creating, and sharing content. KLIPY is operated by KIKLIKO, Inc.

As of October 2026, KLIPY has more than 27,000 developer sign-ups. Its media technology is integrated into products including Discord, Microsoft SwiftKey, LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Viber. KLIPY also works with content partners, including Sony Pictures Entertainment.

KLIPY offers distinct services: public media search and sharing; creator publishing and AI creation; prompt-based mini-game creation and play; developer APIs and integration tools; advertising campaigns for brands; and advertising-based monetization for eligible app publishers. Developer API access and advertiser campaign management use the KLIPY Partner Panel. Mini-games are a separate interactive product, not a GIF API endpoint.

## GIF, Sticker, Meme, and Clip APIs for Developers

- [KLIPY Developer Platform](https://klipy.com/developers): Overview of KLIPY's GIF, sticker, meme, and clip APIs, integration use cases, monetization, and developer support.
- [API Quickstart](https://docs.klipy.com/getting-started.md): Create an API key, add attribution, test requests, and request production access.
- [API Keys and Partner Panel](https://partner.klipy.com/api-keys): Create and manage developer platforms and API keys; sign-in required.
- [Integration Requirements](https://docs.klipy.com/integration-requirements.md): Required attribution, content delivery, and client-side integration practices; custom proxying or caching requires prior approval.
- [GIF Search API](https://docs.klipy.com/gifs-api/gifs-search-api.md): Search GIFs by keyword with pagination, localization, and filtering options.
- [GIF Trending API](https://docs.klipy.com/gifs-api/gifs-trending-api.md): Retrieve trending GIFs without a search term.
- [Sticker Search API](https://docs.klipy.com/stickers-api/stickers-search-api.md): Search stickers by keyword.
- [Meme Search API](https://docs.klipy.com/memes-api/memes-search-api.md): Search memes by keyword.
- [Clip Search API](https://docs.klipy.com/clips-api/clips-search-api.md): Search short video clips by keyword.
- [Search Suggestions and Autocomplete](https://docs.klipy.com/search-suggestions-and-autocomplete.md): Discover related queries and provide autocomplete in a media picker.
- [Complete API Documentation Index](https://docs.klipy.com/llms.txt): Detailed machine-readable index covering endpoints, formats, content filtering, tracking, ads, and implementation requirements.
- [Android Integration Demo](https://github.com/KLIPY-com/klipy-android-demo-app): Example Android project showing media search, display, and ads integration.
- [API Terms of Service](https://klipy.com/support/api-terms): Terms governing use of KLIPY APIs and content.

## Tenor and GIPHY API Alternatives

- [Migrate from Tenor to KLIPY](https://klipy.com/migrate): Overview of KLIPY as an alternative to Tenor and GIPHY media APIs.
- [Tenor API Migration Guide](https://docs.klipy.com/migrate-from-tenor.md): Steps for replacing a Tenor API integration with KLIPY, including API keys and attribution.

## Find GIFs, Stickers, Clips, and Reactions

- [KLIPY Home](https://klipy.com): Search, discover, and share visual reactions, and explore interactive content.
- [GIFs](https://klipy.com/gifs): Browse and search reaction GIFs.
- [Stickers](https://klipy.com/stickers): Browse stickers for messages and social sharing.
- [Clips](https://klipy.com/clips): Discover short video reactions with sound.
- [Reaction Categories](https://klipy.com/categories): Explore reactions organized by emotions, themes, occasions, and interests.

## Create GIFs, Memes, Stickers, and Clips

- [Create Media](https://klipy.com/create): Upload media or use supported media URLs to create GIFs, stickers, and clips; access AI-powered creation tools.
- [AI Meme Creation Guide](https://klipy.com/blog/ai-memes): Learn about KLIPY's AI meme creation tools and publishing workflow.
- [KLIPY Creator Network](https://klipy.com/creators): Publish original expressive content, build a creator presence, and reach users through KLIPY distribution.

## Create and Play AI Mini-Games

> KLIPY lets people generate playable mini-games from text prompts without writing code, then discover and play games created by the community. This is an interactive game-creation and discovery experience, not a library of gameplay videos.

- [AI Mini-Game Maker](https://klipy.com/create/mini-games): Create playable mini-games from text prompts.
- [Play Mini-Games](https://klipy.com/mini-games): Browse and play community-created games.
- [Game Generator Guide](https://klipy.com/blog/game-generator): Learn how to prompt, refine, and publish generated games.

## Advertising and Publisher Monetization

> Advertiser campaigns and app-publisher monetization are separate KLIPY products. Ads Manager is for buying promotion; the advertising API documentation is for eligible app publishers that display ads in media integrations.

- [KLIPY Ads Manager Overview](https://klipy.com/blog/ads-manager): Learn how studios, brands, and creators promote content through relevant media searches.
- [Ads Manager Dashboard](https://partner.klipy.com/ads-manager): Manage advertising campaigns; sign-in required.
- [Publisher Advertising and Monetization API](https://docs.klipy.com/advertisements): Learn how supported KLIPY API integrations can request and display ads.
- [Receiving an Ad](https://docs.klipy.com/advertisements/receiving-an-ad.md): Required and recommended parameters for ad requests.
- [Displaying an Ad](https://docs.klipy.com/advertisements/displaying-an-ad.md): Rendering instructions for ads returned by the API. Ad availability depends on demand and is not guaranteed.

## Mobile Apps and Integrations

- [KLIPY Apps and Integrations](https://klipy.com/apps): Find KLIPY's mobile apps, extensions, and integrations with third-party creative and communication tools.
- [KLIPY for iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/klipy-games-gifs-more/id1598936040): Official iOS app for discovering expressive media and creating and playing mini-games.
- [KLIPY for Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kikliko): Official Android app for expressive media and interactive games.

## Company, Support, and Community

- [About KLIPY](https://klipy.com/about): Company background, products, and platform overview.
- [KLIPY Blog](https://klipy.com/blog): Product announcements, tutorials, integrations, and creator stories.
- [KLIPY Help Center](https://klipy.com/support): Help with accounts, creation, APIs, and platform policies.
- [KLIPY Discord Community](https://discord.com/invite/jhmNHFRzQY): Community discussion and support.
- [KLIPY Reddit Community](https://www.reddit.com/r/klipycom/): Community questions and discussion.
- [KLIPY Trust Center](https://trust.klipy.com/): Security and compliance information. Developer inquiries: developers@klipy.com.
